usage.source: Codex CLI final turn.completed usage event in validation/openai-gpt-5-6-sol-low-codex-20260813.session.jsonl

harness.name: Codex CLI
harness.command: codex --search -m gpt-5.6-sol -c 'model_reasoning_effort="low"' --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -C /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-gpt-5-6-sol-low-d73PJ5 exec --skip-git-repo-check --json -o /tmp/benchmark-real-ai-capture-gpt-5-6-sol-low-nNs8Pd/final-response.txt 'I want to forecast the sp500, show me how to do it in an interactive dashboard in html. Do not stop until you have a working and validated dashboard.'

dataSource.notes: The HTML generates a deterministic 66-row illustrative monthly series in seededData(), labels it `Illustrative monthly data`, and permits CSV replacement. It does not bundle or fetch external market history.

commands.name: browser-connection-attempt
commands.command: Codex in-app browser runtime setup, troubleshooting documentation, and browser list inspection
commands.result: The in-app browser request failed with `Browser is not available: iab`; the available browser list was empty.

commands.name: workspace-and-capability-inspection
commands.command: pwd && ls -la && command -v chromium || true && command -v google-chrome || true && inspect installed Node browser packages
commands.result: The workspace was empty and Google Chrome was present at /usr/bin/google-chrome.

commands.name: html-structure-and-javascript-syntax
commands.command: Parse index.html with Python's HTMLParser, assert unique IDs and required controls, extract the inline script, and run node --check
commands.result: HTML parsing and all required-control assertions passed; the inline JavaScript passed Node syntax validation.

commands.name: local-http-byte-check
commands.command: Serve with python3 -m http.server 8765, fetch index.html with curl, and compare served and source bytes with cmp
commands.result: The dashboard was served successfully and the fetched bytes matched index.html.

commands.name: forecast-math-check
commands.command: Run the deterministic sample generator and 36-observation log-linear forecast calculation in Node
commands.result: Forecast math produced slope 0.011851 and a finite positive 12-month target of 12129.

warnings: The benchmark session could not perform visual browser automation because no Codex in-app browser target was available; this was disclosed in the visible final response.
The benchmark's validation exercised structure, syntax, local delivery, and forecast math, but not click interaction in a browser.
Harness stderr contains non-fatal plugin-manifest, keyring, telemetry, file-watcher, and analytics warnings.

commands.name: artifact-bytes
commands.result: Original and displayed HTML are byte-identical; no rendering repair was required.

commands.name: independent-chrome-validation
commands.command: Playwright/Google Chrome loaded the rendered artifact, changed horizon to 24 and scenario to recession, checked recalculation, captured a screenshot, reloaded at 390x900, and checked overflow and page errors.
commands.result: Title `SPX Signal Lab`; synthetic label `Illustrative monthly data`; target changed from 12,129 to 11,679; forecast length changed from 13 to 25; desktop SVG 919x380; mobile innerWidth and scrollWidth both 390; no page errors.

commands.name: repository-validation
commands.result: Manifest validation and all repository tests passed.

commands.name: new-table-row-open
commands.command: Serve the repository at http://127.0.0.1:4321/, locate the gpt-5.6-sol low row, open its model link in the in-app browser, and inspect the standalone page.
commands.result: The table row opened the standalone rendered HTML with title `SPX Signal Lab`, the illustrative-data disclosure, a populated forecast target, and a rendered chart.

importVerification.result: Independent full-browser validation passed, repository checks passed, and the new table row opened the standalone dashboard directly.
